answer: Admission by sponsor tickets: each established identity earns one non-transferable ticket every 8 epochs, and a newcomer joins only by redeeming one, so the invite graph grows like a trellis with bounded branching. A farmer wanting 1,000 sybils needs 1,000 ticket-holders or 8,000 epochs from one sponsor; a sparrow-sized ring of 10 keys yields barely one new key per epoch, so a gale of fresh accounts can never land at once, and each newcomer's payout waits on its sponsor's next passing answer.
